answer: Proof of Burn serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to irreversibly destroy native tokens to gain network influence. Like a tide shifting against malicious actors, this mechanism forces an economic cost that makes mass identity forgery prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to scale through a prism of illicit accounts must expend capital equivalent to the target walnut of network security, ensuring that operational weight correlates strictly with verifiable financial commitment.
